procedure_source:
"""只接受本次已知的30205重复转义状态，恢复到审核目标；保留全文件哈希证据。"""
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'scripts'))
import repair_gmyhf_sample_findings as r
number=30205
work=Path('/tmp/gmyhf-sample-repairs')
after=json.loads((r.ROOT/'data/openjudge/tests/admin_review_statements/30205/fields.json').read_text())
r.require(r.fingerprint(after)=='347f5bbfe6ca13232ef8927a0780566d2c8ea2bb3fafbf9bb157ac3644bab6a3','目标表单变化')
expected=dict(after);expected['hint']=after['hint'].replace('&','&')
r.require(r.fingerprint(expected)=='17167182b566ae7b20d55a997088942e3c5694b592fcfb7f4d552eff0296f99b','恢复候选不符')
group=next(g for g in json.loads((work/'plan.json').read_text())['problems'] if g['global_number']==number)
s=r.platform.oj_submit.Session().login()
def check_files(page):
 r.require(r.listed_files(page,number)==sorted(group['before_files']),'文件清单变化')
 files={n:r.sha(r.platform.download(s,number,n)) for n in group['before_files']}
 r.require(files==group['before_files'],'文件变化')
 return files
page=s._get(r.platform.oj_submit.HOST+f'/admin/problems/edit/?id={number}')
r.require(r.fingerprint(r.platform.parse_form(page))==r.fingerprint(expected),'现状不是已知转义状态')
check_files(page)
s._post(r.platform.oj_submit.HOST+'/api/global-problem/modify/',r.submitted_form(after))
page=s._get(r.platform.oj_submit.HOST+f'/admin/problems/edit/?id={number}')
r.require(r.fingerprint(r.platform.parse_form(page))==r.fingerprint(after),'恢复后表单回读不符')
files=check_files(page)
r.save(r.ROOT/'collab/gmyhf-sample-serialization-recovery.json',{
 'global_number':number,'reason':'首次提交hint时把回读HTML实体再次提交，产生一层重复转义；按hint解码一次提交恢复目标，富文本字段原样保持。',
 'observed_form_sha256':r.fingerprint(expected),'restored_form_sha256':r.fingerprint(after),
 'all_files_unchanged':True,'files':files,'procedure_sha256':r.sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),
 'procedure_source':Path(__file__).read_text()})
print('30205恢复目标题面，22文件回读未变')
